record.paper_title: Progress and open questions in the physics of neutrino cross sections at intermediate energies
record.original_question: Why is the charged-current to neutral-current coherent pion-production ratio measured by SciBooNE on carbon far below the theoretical expectation and inconsistent with the relation σ_CC-COHπ+ / σ_NC-COHπ0 = 2 that follows for isoscalar nuclei under standard approximations?

evidence.quote: The present experimental situation is puzzling because the upper limits obtained by K2K [19] and SciBooNE [43] coexist with measurements of NC COHπ0 (MiniBooNE [30] and SciBooNE [44]) with a presumably larger cross section.
This result is difficult to accommodate with the relation σCC−COHπ+ /σNC−COHπ0 = 2...
This becomes an open problem and a challenge for both, theory and experimental communities.
Regarding coherent pion production, the SciBooNE measurement of the ratio σCC−COHπ+ /σNC−COHπ0 on carbon is more than 4σ away from the bulk of the theoretical results...

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider neutrino-induced coherent single-pion production on a carbon (¹²C) nucleus, in which the nucleus remains in its ground state. Two channels are of interest:

(i) Charged-current (CC) coherent π⁺ production: ν_μ + ¹²C → μ⁻ + π⁺ + ¹²C, with cross section σ_{CC-COHπ⁺};
(ii) Neutral-current (NC) coherent π⁰ production: ν_μ + ¹²C → ν_μ + π⁰ + ¹²C, with cross section σ_{NC-COHπ⁰}.

Under standard theoretical approximations (PCAC dominance and isospin/isoscalar-target arguments), the cross sections satisfy

   σ_{CC-COHπ⁺} / σ_{NC-COHπ⁰} = 2.

Experimentally on carbon, however, upper limits on σ_{CC-COHπ⁺} at neutrino energies near 1 GeV are reported to coexist with sizeable measured values of σ_{NC-COHπ⁰}, yielding a ratio more than 4σ below the value 2 expected from the relation above and from a wide spread of theoretical models.

Problem: Identify a consistent physical and/or nuclear-model mechanism (or experimental effect) that explains why the measured CC/NC coherent pion-production cross-section ratio on ¹²C at sub-GeV to few-GeV neutrino energies is so strongly suppressed relative to the value 2 predicted by isoscalar-nucleus arguments, and reconcile the existing CC upper limits with the NC measurements within a single framework.
artifact.status_search_result: The discrepancy was a known puzzle around 2010–2014. Subsequent measurements by T2K (including a low-energy CC coherent π⁺ observation on carbon in agreement with microscopic models such as Alvarez-Ruso's) and MINERvA at higher energies have produced CC coherent cross sections broadly consistent with theoretical expectations and inconsistent with the original SciBooNE upper limits, suggesting the SciBooNE result was an outlier rather than evidence against the σ_{CC}/σ_{NC}=2 relation. However, residual tensions in differential distributions remain and a fully unified description has not been definitively established, so the issue is partially resolved.

status_evidence.title: Measurements of the ν_μ and anti-ν_μ-induced coherent charged pion production cross sections on ¹²C by the T2K experiment
status_evidence.snippet: T2K reports CC coherent π⁺ cross sections on carbon, observing a signal consistent with modern microscopic models.
status_evidence.claim: Newer T2K CC coherent measurements on carbon contradict the original SciBooNE upper limits, partially resolving the puzzle.

status_evidence.title: Charged Current Coherent Pion Production in Neutrino Scattering
status_evidence.snippet: K2K and SciBooNE upper limits were significantly lower than Rein-Sehgal but agreed with Berger-Sehgal; MINERvA measurements agreed with both models on the total cross section though differential distributions show forward-region excess.
status_evidence.claim: Updated models (Berger-Sehgal, microscopic models) and MINERvA/T2K data have moved the field toward agreement, though differential discrepancies persist.

status_evidence.title: PDG Review: Neutrino cross section measurements
status_evidence.snippet: Summary of CC and NC coherent pion measurements and theoretical models.
status_evidence.claim: The status as of recent PDG reviews indicates remaining tensions but no longer an unresolved 4σ discrepancy.
